name: autoclip
description: AutoClip｜一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。Open-source AI video clipping & content repurposing.
one_liner: Paste in a podcast or long video link and it automatically cuts it into short clips with captions, covers, and post copy ready for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
buyer: A podcaster or online course creator who wants social clips every week but can't afford a dedicated video editor.
business_use_cases: A podcaster auto-generates 10 short clips per episode for TikTok and Reels instead of paying an editor per clip.
A social media agency offers 'podcast-to-shorts' repurposing as a service for clients, running this in bulk instead of hiring editors.
A course creator turns long lecture videos into bite-sized promotional clips to drive course sales on social platforms.

money_ideas.idea: Run a 'clips done for you' monthly retainer for podcasters and creators.
Charge per episode for a one-off clipping and captioning service.

steal_this: Offer three podcasters a free first episode of auto-clipped shorts this week, then sell a $200/month 'clips done for you' retainer.
